items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: When I saw (Que?) at Charlie Shavers, she Procope started to telling (Poke?) and them, Poke wife you know.

ctx.x: I never did forget that thing.
I said, and now they call me wife-in-law. (LAUGHTER). That's what Johnny and Cue call me, say, hello wife in-law. (LAUGHTER). Oh yes they still laugh.
When I saw (Que?) at Charlie Shavers, she Procope started to telling (Poke?) and them, Poke wife you know. Say, this Marge is something else. (LAUGHTER).
